rationale: The assistant gave specific buying criteria and listed brands, mildly out of scope, though it did not endorse a model. It then pivoted well to the old machine's drain fault, with safe unplug-first instructions and a sensible diagnostic path. The later turns repeated the same 'report back' requests and added filler tips, but the customer was stalling, so the repetition did not block progress and the case stays unresolved.
